title: TerraBase Studio API contract (pre-landing shape of the SE-08 C# API host surface)
notes: Authored by studio ticket TerraScale/TerraBaseV2#16 (DB-02) before the sync wave lands.

The shape follows the SE-04 frame vocabulary (session open/resume, delta frames, heartbeat, resync-required, fatal errors; envelope discipline: version, frame type, correlation/causation IDs, idempotency key, content digest, fail closed) and the engine PublicOperation set in src/operations.rs (DocumentRead, DocumentWrite, Query, Family Read/Write).

The fixture server (scripts/fixture-server.mjs) implements this contract locally; when SE-08 lands, the integration flag STUDIO_API_BASE_URL flips to the real C# API host and any drift is reconciled there.
Every request, response, and frame is typed and versioned; unknown versions, unknown frame types, correlation mismatches, and digest mismatches fail closed.

Operator session bootstrap is host-enforced (see `session`): the default local host surface is ungated (charter PD-2026-08-26-11 — the studio is a local operator tool without an auth gate); a host that does enforce an operator session answers typed operations with the `session.unauthenticated` error and a `loginUrl`, and the studio's only client-side behavior is honoring that redirect. The studio never sends or logs credentials on this surface.

unauthenticated.errorLoginUrl: absolute or host-relative URL of the host's login flow, carried as ApiError.loginUrl; the studio redirects there and adds no auth logic of its own
unauthenticated.note: the fixture server simulates this behavior under fixture control (`session-gate`) so the bootstrap is testable before SE-08 lands

fields.op: operation name; must match the route segment
fields.correlationId: caller-generated UUID; echoed verbatim in the response
fields.causationId: optional UUID of the originating request this one continues
fields.idempotencyKey: optional caller identity for idempotent mutations (document.write, family.write)

fields.op: operation name; must match the request
fields.error: ApiError on HTTP >= 400: { code, message, retryable }

frame.transport: SSE (text/event-stream); one frame per SSE message on the default message channel (no named event: lines, so unknown frame types reach consumers and must fail closed); SSE id is '<sessionId>:<seq>' so the browser resume path carries the SE-04 Sync Checkpoint

fields.type: frame type from the subscription's frame list
fields.seq: monotonic per-subscription sequence; deltas replay with their original seq (at-least-once identities)
fields.correlationId: optional; links the frame to a caller correlation
fields.causationId: optional; links the frame to the originating operation
fields.idempotencyKey: optional; present on frames derived from idempotent mutations
fields.digest: 'sha256:<hex>' over the canonical JSON of payload (object keys sorted recursively)

EngineRole.doc: Replication role of the engine process the host is supervising.

fields.name: collections
fields.doc: Number of collections in the catalog.

fields.name: documents
fields.doc: Number of documents across collections.

fields.name: walBytes
fields.doc: Current write-ahead log size in bytes.

fields.name: engineId
fields.doc: Stable engine process identity.

fields.name: engineVersion
fields.doc: Engine build version.

fields.name: startedAt
fields.doc: ISO-8601 UTC engine start time.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: Published version from DocumentMetadata.

fields.name: document
fields.doc: Absent (null) when the document does not exist.

fields.name: expectedVersion
fields.doc: ExpectedVersion precondition; absent means create-or-replace.

fields.name: operationId
fields.doc: Stable OperationId for retry identity.

CommitReceipt.doc: CommitOutcome projected to the public surface.

fields.name: committedAt
fields.doc: ISO-8601 UTC commit time.

QueryInput.doc: The engine accepts Typed(QuerySpec) and V1Compatible text; the pre-landing shape carries the v1 text form only and records the typed form as a contract TODO for SE-08.

fields.name: projected
fields.doc: Named typed expression projections (never arbitrary code).

FamilyKind.doc: The closed set of engine Data Family kinds. The wire names are the engine's reserved family record keys (src/families/state.rs family_key): identities=Identity ranges, lifecycle=ExpirationRefresh, archival=Archival, validation=SchemaValidation (PD-2026-08-26-04), tombstones=ConflictTombstones. Unknown kinds fail closed.

fields.name: scope
fields.doc: Family scope selector (e.g. collection or counter group).

fields.name: operation
fields.doc: Typed family mutation payload (validated per kind).

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable machine-readable error code.

fields.name: message
fields.doc: Human-readable; never contains credentials or document bodies.

fields.name: loginUrl
fields.doc: Present only on session.unauthenticated: the host-enforced login flow entry; the studio redirects there.

fields.name: resumable
fields.doc: Whether the session retains frames for checkpoint resume.

fields.name: checkpoint
fields.doc: Sync Checkpoint the consumer may resume from.

fields.name: lastSeq
fields.doc: High-water frame seq at establishment: on a resume, replayed deltas carry seq in (checkpoint seq, lastSeq] and live deltas carry seq > lastSeq, so consumers can classify replay vs live exactly.

TickDeltaPayload.doc: The trivial tick feed proving live plumbing before real data flows (DB-02).

operations.name: engine.status
operations.doc: Host-level typed read wrapping engine identity, storage stats, and operation counters.

operations.name: family.read
operations.doc: PublicOperation::Family(FamilyReadRequest). Unknown FamilyKind values fail closed with family.kind-unknown.

subscriptions.name: ticks
subscriptions.doc: Trivial live tick feed (session open/resume, delta frames, heartbeat, resync-required, fatal errors) proving the studio's live plumbing end-to-end against the SE-04 envelope discipline.
subscriptions.resume: SSE Last-Event-ID carries '<sessionId>:<seq>'; the server replays missed deltas from the session buffer with their original seq identities; an evicted or unknown checkpoint yields resync.required
